This was done in an attempt to boost ticket sales at Allegiant Stadium. After numerous casinos, hotels, and tourism-related businesses expressed frustration with the limitation, the Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority Board of Directors pushed back on the decision, noting that when they agreed to pay a site fee to bring WrestleMania to the city, the expectation was that the event would generate economic benefits across the city as a whole - not just for WWE and the venue hosting the show.
